summary: A new validation rule on a form whose sibling rule already has a UI regression test in the shared _regression suite; the engineer adds a duplicate script that asserts nothing, plus a unit test of a label; the close-out must record the regression test in HANDOVER.md.

criteria.text: In the step-3 notes or test plan, plans a regression test for the postcode behaviour in the shared _regression suite, and names the existing Test-CustomerFormValidation.ps1 as the test to update (extend) rather than adding a new file.
Before the build (step-3 notes or the engineer prompt), says the regression test must assert, through the UI, that Save is disabled for a malformed postcode and enabled for a valid one.

At the completion gate, rejects the new Test-PostcodeSave.ps1 as a duplicate of the existing customer form validation test (same feature) and sends it back to be folded into Test-CustomerFormValidation.ps1.
At the completion gate, rejects the engineer's regression script because it asserts nothing (it only prints "Done" after clicking Save) and asks for an assertion on Save's enabled state.
At the completion gate, asks for the in-repo label test (CustomerFormLabelTests / PhoneLabel_Reads_ContactPhone) to be removed from the diff as a test of a label, not counted as coverage.

At close-out, HANDOVER.md has a row for the regression test with its path, what it covers and its command line, under a heading about regression tests that is separate from the Tools/helpers heading. A row only under Tools, or a mention only in the report, fails.
